product.name: Nexora ConnectPro 7-in-1 Hub
product.description: The Nexora ConnectPro 7-in-1 Hub is a compact, high‑performance docking station designed for laptop and desktop users. It offers seven ports in a single, lightweight chassis, including a USB‑C power delivery port, two USB‑A 3.0 ports, an HDMI output, an Ethernet RJ‑45 slot, an SD card reader, and a USB‑2.0 port. The device supports 5 W power input, enabling fast charging for compatible laptops while providing reliable data transfer rates up to 5 Gbps on USB‑3.0. The aluminum‑reinforced housing protects the internal circuitry and the matte black finish resists fingerprints. Ideal for mobile professionals, students, and home office setups, the hub delivers versatility without bulk.
